claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the University of Connecticut (UConn) men's basketball team.
Dan Hurley led UConn men's basketball team to a 2023 National Championship.
Dan Hurley led UConn men's basketball team to a 2026 Final Four appearance.
Dan Hurley has been the head coach of UConn men's basketball team since March 22, 2018.
Kimani Young is the associate head coach of UConn men's basketball.
Luke Murray is an assistant coach of UConn men's basketball.
Mike Nardi is an assistant coach of UConn men's basketball.
Dan Hurley was a high school coach at St. Benedict's Prep.
Dan Hurley was the head coach at Wagner College.
Dan Hurley was the head coach at the University of Rhode Island.
As of April 2026, Dan Hurley has secured his third Final Four appearance in four years.
Geno Auriemma is the head coach of UConn women's basketball team.
Geno Auriemma has led the UConn women's basketball team for over four decades.
Geno Auriemma has earned 12 National Championships
